note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts, lists, scalars). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is used declaratively by the MMSegmentation training framework to configure a Sapiens 1B depth estimation model on the RenderPeople dataset.
run_depth_training: run the sapiens 1b depth estimation model training on the render people synthetic dataset for 200 epochs
configure_depth_model: configure a depth estimator model with a vision transformer backbone and vit depth head for monocular depth estimation
set_optimizer_params: set the adamw optimizer with layer decay rate 0.85 and gradient clipping for the sapiens 1b model
define_train_pipeline: define the training data pipeline with random resize, depth crop, rotation, flip, and photometric distortion augmentations
setup_learning_rate_schedule: setup a linear warmup followed by polynomial learning rate decay schedule over 200 epochs
